title: My village
instructions: Rosa köyünü anlatıyor. Köyde ne olduğuna ve ne olmadığına dikkat et.

script.speaker: rosa
script.text: I live in a small village in the mountains.

script.speaker: rosa
script.text: There are about two hundred people here.

script.speaker: rosa
script.text: There is a school, a small shop and a church.

script.speaker: rosa
script.text: There isn't a cinema or a hospital.

script.speaker: rosa
script.text: The air is clean and it is very quiet.

script.speaker: rosa
script.text: I love my village, but in winter it is very cold.

questions.prompt: How many people live in the village?
questions.feedback: Köyde yaklaşık iki yüz (two hundred) kişi yaşıyor.
questions.evidence: There are about two hundred people here.

questions.prompt: What is NOT in the village?
questions.evidence: There isn't a cinema or a hospital.

questions.prompt: What is the problem in winter?
questions.evidence: in winter it is very cold.
